title: Xray core tech stack selection
rationale: Chose battle-tested Rust ecosystem crates for each concern: tree-sitter for parsing (production-grade, used by major editors), petgraph for graph (standard Rust graph lib), Sigma.js for rendering (WebGL, 50K nodes at 60fps), wasm-pack for WASM bridge. Prioritized performance, single-binary distribution, and leveraging mature libraries over custom implementations.

name: lead-agent-research-delivery
description: Lead agent research workflow: parallel web searches across domains, synthesize into structured findings per domain (recommendations, trade-offs, risks), deliver via ov mail in numbered sections to coordinator and spec-writer. For research-only tasks without code output, mail is the delivery mechanism since lead agents cannot write files.

content: Xray workspace file layout (M0 confirmed): crates/{xray-core,xray-cli,xray-wasm}, grammars/*.scm, web/{src,index.html,package.json,tsconfig.json}, .github/workflows/ci.yml, justfile. wasm-pack target: web. All 3 acceptance criteria verified: cargo build, cargo test, wasm-pack build.

name: wasm-safe-core-deps
description: Cargo workspace wasm compatibility: xray-core uses cfg(not(target_arch='wasm32')) to gate native-only deps (ignore, rayon, rusqlite, bincode, blake3). Only wasm-safe deps (serde, petgraph, thiserror) in unconditional [dependencies].

content: GraphBuilder uses petgraph::StableGraph<Node, (), Directed> internally with a HashMap<NodeId, NodeIndex> for deduplication, then exports to flat XrayGraph (Vec<Node>, Vec<Edge>) for serde serialization. Two-pass build: nodes first, then edges.

bincode 2.x serde compatibility: add features=["serde"] to bincode dep in Cargo.toml, use bincode::serde::encode_to_vec(val, bincode::config::standard()) and bincode::serde::decode_from_slice. All xray types already have Serialize/Deserialize so no additional derives needed.

NodeId generation: blake3::hash(path.as_bytes()).to_hex()[..16].to_string() gives a 16-char hex string stable across re-scans. Gated on #[cfg(not(target_arch = wasm32))] since blake3 is native-only dep.

SQLite cache (CacheDb) stores ImportDecl as JSON via a mirror CachedImport struct (with Serialize/Deserialize) since scanner::ImportDecl doesn't derive serde traits. Conversion From<&ImportDecl> and From<CachedImport> defined in cache/db.rs.

name: blast-radius-adjacency-bfs
description: blast_radius efficiency: build forward/reverse HashMap<&str,Vec<&str>> from graph edges once, then BFS with VecDeque. Avoids O(nodes*edges) linear scan. Tests cover transitive closure and cycle safety.
